title: Please
label: ch:hi-please
canDo: I can say please in Hindi, both with कृपया and with the polite verb ending everyday speech actually prefers.

payoff.summary: Complete HI-C08-checkpoint, the chapter's closing checkpoint: say कृपया and unpack it as 'of your compassion', switch to the everyday बैठिए, say why कृ is read kri, find अ and ◌े in words you already say, then write कृ, अ and मे from sound.
payoff.note: HI-C08-checkpoint (sequence 517, HI-PATH-012 order 1, after HI-S112-vowel-sign-e and before chapter 9's HI-C09-maaf-kijiye) assesses all five atoms the chapter introduces (5/5). The chapter's sequence and its path disagreed: HI-C08-kripaya (510) is first by sequence but last on the path, because its three one-character segments, HI-S144-vowel-sign-vocalic-r, HI-S03-letter-a and HI-S112-vowel-sign-e (511-516), sit in the early HI-PATH-100 segment. So कृपया could not assess them, and none of them could take कृपया's atoms. The checkpoint comes after all four lessons on both orders, so it can honestly assess every atom; HI-C08-kripaya stays as the chapter's spoken lesson (2/5 on its own).
